software_class: mobile-first product with device constraints, app lifecycle, and network variability

options.name: Native platform application
options.when_to_use: Platform integration, performance, or native UX quality is central.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when cross-platform speed matters more than platform depth.
options.rationale: Maximizes device fit and platform conventions.
options.risks: Feature parity can drift across platforms.

options.name: Cross-platform mobile application
options.when_to_use: Shared product logic and faster multi-platform delivery matter.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when deep platform APIs dominate.
options.tradeoffs: May need native bridges for advanced features.
options.risks: Generic UI can weaken platform fit.

options.name: Local-first mobile application
options.when_to_use: Offline continuity and sync are central requirements.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when data must always be server-authoritative.
options.tradeoffs: Sync conflicts need explicit product rules.
options.risks: Data integrity risks increase without a clear model.

options.name: Progressive web mobile surface
options.when_to_use: Install friction must be low and native features are limited.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when store distribution or native APIs are required.
options.risks: Users may expect app-store behavior that is unavailable.
